name: Alphabet Inc. (Class C)
blurb: Alphabet is the parent company of Google, headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its principal revenue source is Google Search advertising, which has historically contributed approximately 55–60% of total revenue, supplemented by YouTube advertising, Google Cloud, and hardware. Google Cloud (GCP) is Alphabet's fastest-growing segment and competes directly with AWS and Azure for enterprise and AI workloads. Alphabet designs its own AI accelerators — tensor processing units (TPUs) — through Google DeepMind, reducing reliance on NVIDIA GPUs and enabling tight hardware-software co-design. GOOG is the Class C non-voting share; GOOGL is the Class A voting share. Both trade on NASDAQ.
recent: Alphabet reported Google Cloud revenue growing 48% year-on-year in Q4 2025, with a $240 billion backlog — a 55% sequential jump. Gemini, Google's flagship AI model family, reached 750 million monthly active users with serving costs per unit down 78% over 2025 through model and hardware optimisations. Alphabet outlined 2026 capital expenditures of $175–185 billion, more than double its 2025 spend, to support AI infrastructure expansion. Google Cloud Next 2026 showcased 8th-generation TPUs (split into TPU 8t for training and TPU 8i for inference) and Gemini Enterprise, positioning Alphabet as a serious competitor to the OpenAI ecosystem for enterprise agentic AI workloads.
